text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a field of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important part of NLP is text understanding, which allows machines to find meaning in written words. NLP also makes translation possible, so people can read texts in different languages. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, which helps companies discover whether customers feel positive or negative about a product. Finally, chatbots use NLP to communicate with people in a natural way and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, we can now interact with technology more easily and in a more human way.
